description.value: The DoubleTree by Hilton Kelowna is a full-service hotel situated on Highway 97 North, one of the main arterial routes through the Okanagan. As part of the Hilton brand, it offers a consistent mid-to-upscale experience with broad accessibility. Its location on a major highway corridor makes it a convenient overnight stop for cyclists touring the Okanagan Valley.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website fetch returned Hilton.com error pages ('Something went wrong') on all subpages, providing no usable amenity information. All amenity fields therefore rely solely on OSM tags, which confirm Wi-Fi (internet_access=wlan) and wheelchair accessibility but say nothing about bike storage or other cycling amenities. The OSM record has a recent check_date of 2026-04-03, supporting that the property is currently open.
concerns: Website fetch failed — all subpages returned Hilton error pages ('Something went wrong'); no amenity information could be extracted from the website. All amenities except Wi-Fi are unverifiable and set to null.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating Hilton-brand hotel on a major cycling corridor in Kelowna; OSM check_date of 2026-04-03 confirms it remains open.

price.label: Upscale
price.signal: Genuine DoubleTree by Hilton; Kelowna rates ~$180-250 shoulder
